trades.name: LI
trades.why: Vehicle margin went from 9.4% to 15.3% a quarter ahead of management's own target, cash flow turned positive and Q4 is guided to a profit; the stock took that over a soft volume guide, +11% on 3.5x volume closing near the high, and the 12-1 delivery figure should show a large step up from October because the guide was given with most of November known.
trades.wrong_if: Li Auto reports November deliveries under about 36,000 on 12-1 (the Q4 guide needs 40,000-43,000 a month); or it lowers the Q4 delivery guide of 110,000-115,000 or the Q4 profit target; or two or more covering brokers downgrade it after the print, inside the window.
trades.deferred_from: queued for 8:35 AM CT: spread wider than 0.5% (LI 0.5%)

trades.name: ITUB
trades.why: Lula named Bradesco's chairman Luiz Trabuco finance minister on Thursday and the Planalto confirmed he accepted; Brazil's index rose 6.1% with long rates down more than 50 bp, it is still about 20% under its October peak after the election selloff, and a re-rating of the fiscal risk premium on a confirmed appointment usually takes more than one session. Itau is the cleanest bank to hold it in.
trades.wrong_if: Trabuco withdraws or Lula walks back the appointment; or Lula names an economic team or sets terms that the Brazilian press reports as overruling him on the surplus target; or the long-end swap rates and the real give back Thursday's move (rates retrace the 50 bp, USD/BRL back above about 5.80) on political pushback, inside the window.
